verdict.rationale: Better Auth's first-party twoFactor plugin documents TOTP authenticator-app setup as the default method, plus email/SMS OTP, backup-code generation for recovery, enabling and disabling 2FA, and trusted-device management. Nothing in the pack shows that a security engineer can require MFA for all users or force a step-up check for sensitive actions, so the reviewer's concern stands and the verdict stays partial. Missing for 10: documented ability to mandate MFA for users, step-up re-authentication for sensitive actions, independent hands-on corroboration of the 2FA plugin.
